annotations.text:
Printing these

Drawn at 8 px = 1 mm, which is 203 dpi — the printer's own resolution. Export an artboard as PNG and drop it into Tiny Print at 100%; don't let it resample.

Each one is 48 mm wide, leaving about 2 mm of margin each side on the 52 mm paper. If your printable width turns out to be different, say so and I'll redraw — these are sized to the dot, not scaled.

Pure black on white, no grey — thermal has no half-tones, and anything grey comes out a muddy dither.

All three QRs were checked at true size after a hard black-and-white threshold: they still scan to https://maxgrossman.com.
